AI training on your own tasks

One-to-one sessions for specialists and small teams. Participants work on a real task from their job in ChatGPT, Claude or Claude Code and build the solution themselves, guided by the consultant. The meeting plan is built around the participant's task.

1.0 // WHO IT IS FOR

Who comes to the sessions

HR and recruiting: candidate screening, correspondence, meeting transcripts and notes.

Finance and administration: document analysis, reports, summaries.

Owners of small companies who want to automate repetitive tasks without ordering a system from a vendor.

2.0 // HOW IT WORKS

Working on the participant's task

  1. Free 30-minute call: the task, the tools available, how many sessions it may take.
  2. Before the session the participant sends a task description and sample materials. A plan is prepared from them.
  3. In the session the task is described together: goal, inputs, expected output, what to avoid. This becomes prompts or a specification for Claude Code.
  4. The participant carries out the steps on their own computer. The consultant guides, explains and corrects.
  5. After the session, a short summary: what works, what is left, what the next step is.

This is what a single session plan looks like: a fragment of a real facilitator's sheet from the fourth meeting with a recruitment agency.

3.0 // WHAT STAYS

Session outcome

After each meeting: a finished part of the work, a checked result and the next step.

After the series: a script, a prompt template or a simple workflow on the participant's computer, if the task is feasible with the chosen tools.

The expected outcome of each meeting is agreed in advance.

The ability to describe the next task so that the AI model does what is needed.

Knowing when ChatGPT or Claude is enough and when Claude Code is needed.

Before: "I want meeting summaries from Teams done automatically" and a manual chain: calendar, meeting, download the transcript, paste it into a chat. After the transcripts session, the agency was left with this.

Folder or commandPurpose
new/new transcripts from Teams
processed/processed files
summaries/summaries in the agency's template
CLAUDE.mdprocessing rules for Claude Code
fields.mdsummary fields and allowed values
registry.mdregistry of all meetings
/summarizeone command: process new transcripts
/findsearch meetings in plain words

The criteria file improves the system

01

The agency's expert dictates the role criteria: must-haves, nice-to-haves, red flags. They go into a separate file.

02

Claude Code reviews an anonymised CV against that file and writes a recommendation in the agency's template.

03

The first result is usually weak. The missing piece in the criteria file is found and a line is added.

04

The run is repeated until the expert is satisfied. The client describes the next role on their own.

4.0 // PRICING AND TERMS

Payment for agreed time

Session: from 250 zł per hour, net. Usually 60–90 minutes.

The number of sessions depends on the task and is estimated on the free call. A simple task may take one session, a complex one several.

For a team of several people, the price is set after the free call.

Advance payment, rescheduling, cancellation and invoicing follow the same terms as consulting.

Sessions online in Google Meet or Microsoft Teams, in Polish, Russian and Ukrainian.

5.0 // FORMAT LIMITS

What this format does not include

This is not a course with a syllabus, slides and homework. Between sessions the solution is not built for the participant, and a finished automation is not promised. If a vendor needs to build a system, start with a specification. If the processes of a whole department need assessing first, see the audit. If you only need advice, without hands-on work, a consultation fits.
